name: Furnace
description: The town's headquarters and the first building unlocked. Its level caps the max level of every other building, contributes power, and keeps survivors warm through day/night cycles and snowstorms.

name: Embassy
description: An Alliance building that stores reinforcements sent by Alliance members and determines how much construction, research, and healing assistance you can receive. Upgrading it is typically required before the Furnace can advance to the next level.

name: Research Center
description: Where players research new technologies across three tabs (Growth, Economy, and Battle) to strengthen their town. Caps out at Level 30 with no Fire Crystal tier.
